misc.endOverlay.victoryDesc: Every enemy capital has fallen; the Azure Federation has united the continent.
misc.endOverlay.defeatDesc: The capital has fallen and the Azure Federation's banner has vanished from the continent.
misc.feed.empty: No battle reports to expand over the last 3 [[turn]].
misc.layout.balanceTip: When enabled, starting strength is compensated: nations with less territory than the average receive extra state farms and infrastructure (up to +3 each, prioritizing the largest states). The more territory a nation has, the less it receives; the strongest industrial power receives nothing. Infrastructure boosts both output and supply, helping smaller nations defend their homeland. When disabled, the original strength gaps from world generation remain, making for a more dramatic world.
misc.layout.defaultHint: Click a province to inspect · Click an army to take command · Ctrl+click army rows to multi-select and merge · Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · Right-click to cancel
misc.layout.claimBanner: Claim management is active — press Esc to exit
misc.layout.settings.colorNote: Gradient: zooming out past the threshold darkens the whole map; when zoomed in, countries are lightly shaded with their borders outlined in the national color. Uniform: every country uses the same shade. Resources: provinces are shaded by resources — gold for [[raw]], green for [[food]], pink for [[strategic]], purple for both deposits; darker colors mean richer deposits. Hover a province for its actual output.
misc.layout.start.tagline: Voronoi world map · Army strategy · Single player
misc.layout.summary.armies: At most one army per province, mixing infantry, tanks and artillery; battles resolve daily and organization decides the outcome.
misc.layout.summary.economy: [[funds]], [[manpower]], [[industry]] and [[politics]], plus [[raw]], [[food]] and [[strategic]]; deposits support industry and armaments, food drives population growth, and shortages drag down output.
misc.layout.summary.command: Top resource bar and collapsible tabs; selecting an army enters command mode, with multi-select merges in the list and split groups in the detail window.
misc.layout.summary.note: See "How to play" for the full rules and controls.
misc.layout.generating.title: Generating the world
misc.layout.generating.status: Drawing continents, dividing states, shaping nations…
misc.layout.picker.title: Choose your nation
misc.layout.picker.sub: The world is ready. Click a flag to inspect it, switch nations on the map, then press "Start game" in the top right to begin with the selected nation.
misc.layout.newgame.sub: Choose the world size and generation settings, then generate the world and pick your nation.
misc.layout.newgame.nationHint: With {{min}} nations or more, {{low}}–{{high}} extra vassals are generated (ceded small states or independent weaklings), so the actual total may exceed the setting by {{low}}–{{high}}.
misc.layout.newgame.balanceHint: Off by default: the generated strength gaps remain. When on, small and industrially weak starting nations receive compensation.
misc.layout.newgame.terrainNote: Default uses standard terrain; switch to Custom to tune coastlines, moisture and noise frequency.

misc.index.policy.cancelBody:

Cancelling returns to "{{current}}"; the paid [[politics:{{cost}}]] and daily upkeep are not refunded, and switching again still takes [[turn:{{switchDays}}]].

{{adds}}{{sep}}{{cancels}}
